skill_directive.template: Call the `view_file` tool on `{bundle}-{skill}/SKILL.md` before continuing.
skill_directive.note: Transform 1: a full-line `Skill: {bundle}:{skill}` directive rewrites to a view_file instruction.

read_directive.template: Call the `view_file` tool with `{ AbsolutePath: "{path}" }` before continuing.
read_directive.note: Transform 1: a full-line `Read: {path}` load directive rewrites to a view_file instruction.

Task.note: Backtick-wrapped `Task` tool references rewrite to Antigravity's invoke_subagent tool. The `Task:` entry below is a different string: a full-line dispatch header, rewritten into an invoke_subagent instruction.

AskUserQuestion.note: Backtick-wrapped AskUserQuestion tool references rewrite to ask_question.

Task:.template: Call the `invoke_subagent` tool with `subagent_type: "{target}"` and this prompt body:
Task:.note: A full-line `Task: <agent>` dispatch header (or a bare `Task:` naming its agent on the block's own `subagent_type:` line) has no meaning in Antigravity; it rewrites to an invoke_subagent instruction naming the resolved agent, and its indented prompt block is carried through unchanged. Prose mentioning `Task:` without a block is left alone.

Skill: <entry>.note: The runtime placeholder is reworded target-neutrally in the source.

Monitor.note: The background-completion watch has no direct tool analog; concept prose preserved.
